TEN.name: Dorian Mausi
TEN.detail: The Titans opened Mausi's 21-day practice window Wednesday, Jim Wyatt of the team's official website reports.

TEN.name: Jonah Laulu
TEN.detail: The Titans claimed Laulu off waivers from the Raiders on Wednesday, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

TEN.name: Amani Hooker
TEN.detail: Hooker posted five tackles (two solo) during Sunday's 27-24 loss to Cleveland.

TEN.name: Kevin Winston Jr.
TEN.detail: Winston logged 14 tackles (eight solo) during the Titans' 27-24 loss to the Browns on Sunday.

TEN.name: Anthony Hill Jr.
TEN.detail: Hill logged 12 tackles (five solo) and one forced fumble during the Titans' 27-24 loss to the Browns on Sunday.

TEN.name: Elic Ayomanor
TEN.detail: Ayomanor caught three of his seven targets for 44 yards in the Titans' 27-24 loss to the Browns on Sunday.

TEN.name: Wan'Dale Robinson
TEN.detail: Robinson caught four of seven targets for seven yards during Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Browns.

TEN.name: Gunnar Helm
TEN.detail: Helm caught three of four targets for 24 yards in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Browns.

TEN.name: Cam Ward
TEN.detail: Ward completed 20 of 31 passes for 181 yards with an interception in Sunday's 27-24 loss to Cleveland. He added five yards on two carries.

TEN.name: Tony Pollard
TEN.detail: Pollard carried the ball 25 times for 129 yards and three touchdowns in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Browns. He also caught all three of his targets for 26 yards.

TEN.name: Joey Slye
TEN.detail: Slye made his only field-goal attempt while going 3-for-3 on extra-point tries during Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Browns.

TEN.name: Tony Adams
TEN.detail: Adams (ankle) is active for Sunday's game against the Browns.

TEN.name: Timmy Horne
TEN.detail: The Titans signed Horne from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Jim Wyatt of the team's official site reports.

TEN.name: Joshua Williams
TEN.detail: The Titans activated Williams (pectoral) from reserve/PUP on Saturday.

WSH.name: Javon Kinlaw
WSH.detail: Head coach Dan Quinn said Wednesday that Kinlaw (knee) is "unlikely" to play against the Eagles on Sunday, Zach Selby of the Commanders' official site reports.

WSH.name: Treylon Burks
WSH.detail: Burks (foot) didn't practice Thursday.

WSH.name: Nick Allegretti
WSH.detail: questionable

WSH.name: John Bates
WSH.detail: Bates was a non-participant in Thursday's practice due to a shoulder injury.

WSH.name: Charles Omenihu
WSH.detail: questionable

WSH.name: Laremy Tunsil
WSH.detail: Tunsil (triceps) could potentially return late in the season, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

WSH.name: Jer'Zhan Newton
WSH.detail: The Commanders designated Newton (pectoral) for return to practice from their injured reserve list Wednesday.

WSH.name: Terry McLaurin
WSH.detail: The Commanders placed McLaurin (knee) on injured reserve Wednesday, Zach Selby of the team's official site reports.

WSH.name: Jaylin Lane
WSH.detail: Lane underwent surgery Oct. 9 to repair his fractured and dislocated ankle, and he is expected to be cleared for activities before OTAs, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

WSH.name: Stefon Diggs
WSH.detail: Diggs (hand/hamstring) was a full practice participant Thursday.

WSH.name: Van Jefferson
WSH.detail: The Commanders signed Jefferson to the active roster Wednesday, Zach Selby of the team's official site reports.

WSH.name: Marcus Mariota
WSH.detail: Mariota (knee) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice.

WSH.name: Antonio Williams
WSH.detail: Coach Dan Quinn noted Monday that with Terry McLaurin (knee) out for the season, Stefon Diggs' workload isn't expected to change much, however others, notably Williams, should see added opportunities in McLaurin's looming absence, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

WSH.name: Sonny Styles
WSH.detail: Styles finished Monday's 23-17 loss to the 49ers with 13 tackles (seven solo) and one pass defense.

WSH.name: Drew Stevens
WSH.detail: Stevens made his only field-goal try and converted both of his extra-point attempts during Monday's 23-17 loss at San Francisco.

WSH.name: Austin Ekeler
WSH.detail: Ekeler logged a three-yard carry and caught both of his targets for four yards during the Commanders' 23-17 loss to the 49ers on Monday.

WSH.name: Dyami Brown
WSH.detail: Brown hauled in his only target for six yards during Monday's 23-17 loss versus San Francisco.

WSH.name: Jeremy McNichols
WSH.detail: McNichols accrued five rushes for 13 yards during Monday's 23-17 loss to the 49ers.

WSH.name: Chig Okonkwo
WSH.detail: Okonkwo brought in all seven targets for 69 yards in the Commanders' 23-17 loss to the 49ers on Monday night.

WSH.name: Rachaad White
WSH.detail: White rushed seven times for 27 yards and brought in four of five targets for 30 yards and a touchdown in the Commanders' 23-17 loss to the 49ers on Monday night.

WSH.name: Jayden Daniels
WSH.detail: Daniels completed 29 of 40 passes for 300 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions while adding four rushes for 10 yards in the Commanders' 23-17 loss to the 49ers on Monday night.
